{
  "manifest_version": "frontier-mcp-capabilities-0.3",
  "server": "Delphi Frontier MCP",
  "record_schema": "frontier-record-0.1",
  "review_policy": "frontier-independent-review-0.1",
  "namespace": "delphi-frontier",
  "mode": "write_enabled",
  "principal": null,
  "transport": "streamable-http (stateless, JSON responses); one POST per request at the exact path /mcp",
  "anonymous_reads": true,
  "credentials": "Public reads need no credential. Per request: `Authorization: Bearer <your operator credential>` header ONLY. Never a query string, tool argument or resource; never returned. Each request is authenticated and acts as its own principal; the server holds no shared token. A credential that fails verification is refused, never treated as anonymous. Every write tool needs a valid bearer.",
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "frontier_search",
      "kind": "read",
      "requires_role": null,
      "summary": "Search public records: GIN full-text plus literal text, exact version/id/source pins, kind/status/source/scope/context filters, bounded pages (max 50). Lexical only, no embeddings; relevance is not truth."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_get",
      "kind": "read",
      "requires_role": null,
      "summary": "Retrieve one exact public version and its separate node-local review status."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_neighborhood",
      "kind": "read",
      "requires_role": null,
      "summary": "Read up to 50 typed edges at depth one, including review/dispute relationships."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_events",
      "kind": "read",
      "requires_role": null,
      "summary": "Read an append-only public event page; consumers deduplicate event versions."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_artifacts",
      "kind": "read",
      "requires_role": null,
      "summary": "Find public artifact declarations with evidence, action, context and review links. Does not fetch or verify bytes."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_discover",
      "kind": "read",
      "requires_role": null,
      "summary": "Search with cached hybrid vectors when available; otherwise explicitly fall back to lexical search, without provider calls."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_graph",
      "kind": "read",
      "requires_role": null,
      "summary": "Read a bounded public graph view around an exact version, or an overview; returns typed edges and truncation counts."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_catalogue",
      "kind": "read",
      "requires_role": null,
      "summary": "Return measured public-catalogue counts, unknown categories, and the report's record cap."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_project_inspect",
      "kind": "read",
      "requires_role": null,
      "summary": "Inspect one exact Project version and its pinned members; newer heads are reported, never substituted."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_design_context",
      "kind": "read",
      "requires_role": null,
      "summary": "Read bounded exact-version Project/member annotations with explicit pagination; challenges and replies never settle or resolve the design."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_artifact_inspect",
      "kind": "read",
      "requires_role": null,
      "summary": "Inspect matching Evidence declarations and check for matching bytes in this release's guarded public artifacts tree."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_simulate",
      "kind": "read",
      "requires_role": null,
      "summary": "Run one bounded allowlisted bioelectric or mechanobiology preview; returns an ephemeral SimulationResult, never accepted Evidence."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_engineer",
      "kind": "read",
      "requires_role": null,
      "summary": "Run the existing bounded engineering-constraint solver; returns an ephemeral scoped calculation, not a biological finding."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_formalize",
      "kind": "read",
      "requires_role": null,
      "summary": "Run the bounded exact-expression/Lean proposal service; the result is not a persisted formal Evidence record."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_belief",
      "kind": "read",
      "requires_role": null,
      "summary": "Run the bounded finite-scenario belief solver; consequences are conditional on declared inputs and remain uncalibrated."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_capabilities",
      "kind": "read",
      "requires_role": null,
      "summary": "Manifest of this server: mode, configured principal (never the credential), exact tools, limits and what is deliberately unavailable."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_propose",
      "kind": "write",
      "requires_role": "contributor",
      "summary": "Propose a record version as the configured principal. The result is 'proposed', never accepted; Events are emitted by the store only."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_lease",
      "kind": "write",
      "requires_role": "contributor",
      "summary": "Atomically lease one 'ready' (or expired) Action version for 1..600 seconds. Returns lease_id for later transitions."
    },
    {
      "name": "frontier_transition",
      "kind": "write",
      "requires_role": "contributor (ready: coordinator)",
      "summary": "Move an Action through the execution lifecycle (ready, running, submitted, blocked, cancelled, failed). Acceptance is not reachable here."
    }
  ],
  "not_available": [
    "review / accept / dispute: independent reviewers act through HTTP POST /v1/reviews with their own operator credential",
    "import_bundle, provision, initialize (operator-only)",
    "cloud or durable job execution, arbitrary code, network fetch, publication, and external model inference",
    "the fixed local calculation tools are bounded previews only; they do not create or accept Actions or Evidence",
    "proposed Actions are stored as proposed; a worker must use the existing authorized lease/transition flow and record real outputs separately"
  ],
  "record_kinds": [
    "Problem",
    "Claim",
    "Evidence",
    "Assessment",
    "Action",
    "Actor",
    "ResourceOffer",
    "Interest",
    "Event",
    "Project",
    "Annotation"
  ],
  "schema_resources": "frontier://schema/{kind} returns that kind's payload JSON schema",
  "payload_extensions": [
    "Claim.origin",
    "Problem.approach/scales/context_tags",
    "Action.inputs",
    "Action.proposal",
    "Action.proposal.plan_steps",
    "Evidence.relation/produced_by/artifacts"
  ],
  "limits": {
    "max_record_bytes": 65536,
    "max_bundle_records": 100,
    "search_page_max": 50,
    "lease_seconds": [
      1,
      600
    ]
  },
  "search": {
    "engine": "PostgreSQL full-text (simple dictionary, GIN-indexed) plus literal substring fallback; lexical only, no embeddings, no hybrid; relevance is not truth",
    "filters": [
      "kind|kinds",
      "status",
      "source (URI prefix)",
      "scope",
      "context",
      "include_history"
    ],
    "exact_pins": [
      "version",
      "record id",
      "source URI"
    ],
    "pagination": "opaque next_cursor, pass back as cursor (or legacy after)"
  },
  "transition_states_via_mcp": [
    "ready (coordinator only)",
    "running",
    "submitted",
    "blocked",
    "cancelled",
    "failed"
  ],
  "lease_id_note": "A lease_id is a bearer capability for that lease: keep it inside the leasing agent's session. It is not logged by this server.",
  "write_semantics": "Writes return the store's response verbatim: records start 'proposed'; MCP cannot make anything 'accepted'."
}
